Definition: from G5295 and G3007; to leave under (behind), i.e. (passively) to remain (survive):--be left.
BiblicalUsage: hypoleípō turns up where the Bible says to be left behind, to remain. In Romans 11:3, the text says "and I am left alone."
TheologicalSignificance: This one, hypoleípō, I take at face value: to be left behind, to remain.
